description: Checks a password (or its SHA-1 hash) against Have I Been Pwned with k-anonymity: only 5 hash characters leave the server, nothing is stored or logged. Returns how many breaches it appeared in. 0.001 USDC per call via x402.

password.description: Plaintext password; hashed immediately, never stored

paymentProof.description: Payment proof: USDC tx hash on Polygon or Base (0x...) or Solana tx signature. Omit on the first call to receive the 402 payment instructions, pay, then call again with the proof.

name: password_breach_check
